name: v1rus-android
description: Native-Android layer for v1rus: the Gradle module graph of an Android app (app / feature / core / designsystem) without multiplatform source sets, the Android data layer (Room with a context-bound builder, Ktor on OkHttp with bearer refresh, DataStore), Android test conventions (src/test versus src/androidTest, JUnit with handwritten fakes, Robolectric and Compose test rules), manifest and permission discipline, and the android-pipeline-profile that binds the stack-agnostic feature pipeline to an Android project, plus the test-runner agent. Compose UI, MVI and performance rules come from v1rus-compose.
